notes: The article on הַצְּפִירָה takes the possessive determiner *Thy* the ASV wrote in its place (rule 41). The competing reading treats *Thy* and *thee* as one twice-realized suffix under rule 18, but that suffix stands on אֵלֶיךָ, not in this noun phrase, so rule 41's "only where no other morpheme licenses that determiner" is satisfied.

The italicized *a day of* and *of* are ASV supplies inside the renderings of מְהוּמָה and הֵד (rule 31), so rule 7 does not make them added units. The competing reading takes the supplied *a day of* as an appositional echo of the already-rendered הַיּוֹם; rule 31 keeps it with the substantive it expands.
הָרִים carries no article morpheme, so its *the* is supplied under rule 15 and the *upon* is rule 19's recast construct relation.
